title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.22697v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deployed AI systems are often trained from broad candidate data pools, necessitating data curation towards the deployment test distribution. However, standard data curation methods score training-side criteria rather than directly optimizing deployment match. We introduce TTCov (Test-Time Coverage), a data-level test-conditioned curation method that uses test-side information before training instead of updating model weights at inference. TTCov decomposes deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution. To represent coverage, it builds a task Atlas, a collection of LLM-based atomic propositions (APs) describing deployment-relevant concepts, seeded from open task knowledge and expanded with unmatched APs extracted from unlabeled deployment samples. translated_title: 测试时覆盖率：面向部署感知学习的测试条件化数据筛选
translated_abstract: 已部署的AI系统通常从广泛的候选数据池中进行训练，因此需要针对部署测试分布进行数据筛选。然而，标准的数据筛选方法评估的是训练侧的准则，而非直接优化与部署分布的匹配度。我们提出了TTCov（Test-Time Coverage，测试时覆盖率），这是一种数据层面的测试条件化筛选方法，它在训练之前使用测试侧的信息，而不是在推理时更新模型权重。TTCov将部署条件化的筛选分解为覆盖率与分布两个部分。为了表示覆盖率，它构建了一个任务图集，即一组基于大语言模型（LLM）的原子命题（APs），用于描述与部署相关的概念；这些命题由开放的任务知识作为种子，并通过从无标注部署样本中提取的未匹配原子命题进行扩展。为了表示分布，它以频率来实例化匹配的部署原子命题，从而构建出一个知识图集，将部署分布进行可操作化表示……
tldr: 该论文提出TTCov方法，在训练前利用测试侧信息构建由LLM原子命题及其频率组成的知识图集，将部署条件化的数据筛选分解为覆盖率与分布两部分，从而直接优化训练数据与部署测试分布的匹配度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TTCov, a data-level test-conditioned curation method that leverages test-side information before training to build a Knowledge Atlas of LLM-based atomic propositions and their frequencies, decomposing deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution to directly optimize the match between training data and the deployment test distribution.
